name: AgentHost CLI ABS provisional conformance oracle
description: Language-neutral, provisional baseline that freezes the scoped shipped TypeScript Azure Bot Service (ABS) behavior BEFORE any C# ABS behavior is implemented. Each fixture is exercised by the TypeScript oracle runner against the pinned read-only worktree, and (from cN5 onward) by the C# contract runner. Exact JSON and exit codes are normative; human output is compared by ordered, color/newline-normalized lines.

provisional.reconciliation: cN7 closes cross-language parity against the PINNED TypeScript: all 10 neutral fixtures pass byte/line/exit/mutation parity in BOTH the TypeScript oracle runner and the C# contract runner, deterministically (both run twice, no diff; volatileFields is [] on every fixture, so no value is normalized away). See AgentHostCli.Conformance/README.md 'Cross-language conformance closure (cN7)' for the enumerated normalization rules and contract-change records. Reconciliation against the shared agenthost_cli_amh mN3 oracle remains pending and is completed in cN11; any unresolved difference is recorded explicitly in the evaluation rather than silently normalized away.
provisional.note: The demonstrator does NOT block on the future mN3 artifacts.

pinnedSource.note: The oracle imports the ABS command core and shared output helpers from this pinned, read-only worktree and injects fake Azure dependencies. It never modifies the pinned TypeScript, and it never contacts Azure or an identity provider.

scope.description: Every ABS fixture supplies --msa-app-id, so both implementations take the zero-Graph path: ARM reads/writes only, no Microsoft Graph read or mutation. TypeScript behavior outside this slice is recorded as broader scope, not reproduced here.
excluded: operator authentication behavior (judged against PAC, not this ABS oracle)
